scope: Six A2 provisional compound-noun sense leads; three publisher-higher badges, two matching badges, one no badge. Source indexing not direct dictionary-page access; never assert independently approved CEFR.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: A deep cooking pan with a handle, often used for boiling food.
shortlist_snapshot.burmese_meaning: အစားအစာပြုတ်ရန် အသုံးပြုသော လက်ကိုင်ပါ အိုးငယ်
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: Heat the milk gently in a saucepan before adding the chocolate.

publisher_evidence.sense_paraphrase: Deep cooking pan with straight sides, normally a handle and lid.

records.editorial_risk: A2 draft is below the observed B1 publisher badge; avoid automatically re-tiering without exact-sense human signoff.

unapproved_proposal.burmese_meaning: လက်ကိုင်ပါ အနက်ရှိသော ချက်ပြုတ်အိုးငယ်
unapproved_proposal.original_example: She warmed the soup in a saucepan.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: A small card that can be mailed with a short message, often showing a picture.
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: We sent a postcard to our grandparents from the seaside.

publisher_evidence.sense_paraphrase: Card sent by post without an envelope, often with a picture.

records.editorial_risk: A2 badge aligns with draft word/POS; confirm picture is optional and Myanmar definition does not imply every postcard has one.

unapproved_proposal.burmese_meaning: စာအိတ်မပါဘဲ စာတိုက်က ပို့နိုင်သော ပုံပါလေ့ရှိသည့် ကတ်ပြား
unapproved_proposal.original_example: I sent my aunt a postcard from Bagan.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: A small brush used with toothpaste to clean teeth.
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: Replace your toothbrush when its bristles become worn.

publisher_evidence.sense_paraphrase: Small long-handled brush for cleaning teeth.

records.editorial_risk: A2 badge aligns; toothpaste is usual but not a necessary component of the noun definition.

unapproved_proposal.original_example: He put a new toothbrush in his travel bag.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: A container used for collecting rubbish before it is taken away.
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: Put the empty packet in the dustbin near the kitchen door.

publisher_evidence.sense_paraphrase: Large container for household rubbish, typically kept outside; American equivalents garbage can or trash can.

records.editorial_risk: A2 draft below B1 publisher badge. Original example near kitchen door could suggest an indoor kitchen bin, whereas the cited sense typically refers to an outdoor container.

unapproved_proposal.burmese_meaning: အိမ်အပြင်ဘက်တွင် ထားလေ့ရှိသော အမှိုက်ပုံးကြီး
unapproved_proposal.original_example: The dustbin outside the house was full.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: A place where two roads cross each other.
shortlist_snapshot.burmese_meaning: လမ်းနှစ်လမ်း ဖြတ်ဆုံနေသော လမ်းဆုံနေရာ
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: Turn left at the crossroads after you pass the school.

publisher_evidence.grammar: countable noun; singular and plural form crossroads
publisher_evidence.sense_paraphrase: Road junction where two roads cross; separate figurative decision-point use.

records.editorial_risk: A2 draft below B2 publisher badge. Do not confuse literal road junction with figurative be at a crossroads; singular and plural both crossroads.

unapproved_proposal.burmese_meaning: လမ်းနှစ်လမ်း ဖြတ်ဆုံရာ လမ်းဆုံ
unapproved_proposal.original_example: Turn right at the crossroads beside the petrol station.

shortlist_snapshot.english_definition: A small mat placed by a doorway for wiping shoes.
shortlist_snapshot.burmese_meaning: တံခါးဝတွင် ဖိနပ်သုတ်ရန် ခင်းထားသော ဖျာ
shortlist_snapshot.example_sentence: Please wipe your shoes on the doormat before entering.

publisher_evidence.sense_paraphrase: Mat at a doorway for wiping shoes; separate informal figurative sense means a person accepting poor treatment.

records.editorial_risk: No Cambridge CEFR badge visible in indexed entry; do not infer A2. Literal mat sense must not be confused with figurative person sense.

unapproved_proposal.burmese_meaning: တံခါးဝတွင် ဖိနပ်သုတ်ရန် ခင်းထားသော ဖျာငယ်
unapproved_proposal.original_example: A wet doormat lay outside the front door.
